result.title: VTree: Question-Driven Growth of Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Long-Video Understanding
result.summary: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on. Existing video agents explore on demand but re-explore from scratch for every question and discard their exploration state once an answer is produced, so per-question cost scales with video length. Hierarchical-memory methods instead fix the scope of each depth in advance and deepen along a pre-committed pyramid rather than toward the question. We observe that a video's coarse structure (where its scenes and topics begin and end) is question-independent, whereas which part a question must zoom into, and how deep, is question-dependent. We propose VTree, which builds a coarse hierarchical memory tree over a video once and then, for each question, grows branches only where that question needs depth. The growth is globally routed so any part of the timeline is reachable, sufficiency-gated so drilling stops when the evidence suffices, and query-conditioned so a branch unfolds into the sub-intervals that answer \emph{this} question. Crucially, every expansion is written back into the video memory, allowing later questions to reuse previously discovered structure and evidence without repeating the corresponding expansion process. Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.

AI.brief_summary: 针对长视频超出 VLM 上下文、均匀采样丢失细节的问题，该文提出 VTree：先一次性构建与问题无关的粗粒度分层记忆树，再对每个问题按需在相关位置生长分支，并采用全局路由、充分性门控停止扩展和查询条件化的子区间展开；所有扩展写回视频记忆供后续问题复用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时停止下钻」的充分性门控与「扩展结果写回、跨问题复用」直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡和推理期证据获取状态维护，可作为外部显式证据筛选方案与 latent 内部状态的对照；与 latent 表示本身的联系需核查原文。
